hermes-duplicate-call: Warning shown on the rendered page when the #hermes parser function is used more than once on the same page. Refers to the wikitext parser function tag name, which is not translated.
hermes-duplicate-call-category: {{tracking category name}} Tracking category for pages with duplicate #hermes parser function calls.
hermes-duplicate-call-category-desc: Description on [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for the {{msg-mw|hermes-duplicate-call-category}} tracking category.
hermes-invalid-tag-name: Error shown when a tag passed to the #hermes parser function contains disallowed characters. * $1 - the invalid tag name, as entered by the user (not translated)
hermes-duplicate-tag-name: Error shown when the same tag is passed to the #hermes parser function more than once in a single call. * $1 - the duplicated tag name, normalized (not translated)
hermes-invalid-section: Error shown when an argument of the form tag=section to the #hermes parser function has an empty section name, or the section is missing its leading #. * $1 - the argument, as entered by the user (not translated)
hermes-tag-conflict-category-desc: Description on [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for the {{msg-mw|hermes-tag-conflict-category}} tracking category.
hermes-tag-conflict-warning:
Intro line of the warning box shown, at the bottom of the page, on a page that is itself (one of) the cause(s) of a Hermes tag conflict (see {{msg-mw|hermes-tag-conflict-category}}). Followed by a dynamically-built, untranslated list of "tag name: conflicting page titles". Only shown if $wgHermesWarnings is enabled.
* $1 - link to the page's Hermes links on [[Special:HermesPages]], labelled {{msg-mw|hermes-page-details}}
hermes-ambiguous-links-category-desc: Description on [[Special:TrackingCategories]] for the {{msg-mw|hermes-ambiguous-links-category}} tracking category.
hermes-ambiguous-links-warning:
Intro line of the warning box shown, at the bottom of the page, when this page's outgoing interlanguage links are ambiguous (see {{msg-mw|hermes-ambiguous-links-category}}). Followed by a dynamically-built, untranslated list of "tag name (language): candidate page titles". Only shown if $wgHermesWarnings is enabled.
* $1 - link to the page's Hermes links on [[Special:HermesPages]], labelled {{msg-mw|hermes-page-details}}
hermes-reserved-username: Error shown when trying to create an account whose name starts with "!" and contains a ":", which is reserved for translation projects.
hermes-invalid-project-title: Permission error shown when trying to create/move to a page title starting with "!" and containing a ":" that doesn't match the reserved "!xx:Title" translation-project format, with "xx" being a language code for a registered translation project.
hermes-title-not-capitalized: Permission error shown when trying to create/move to/upload a translation-project page title whose first letter after the "!xx:" prefix isn't capitalized as required by $wgCapitalLinks (or a per-namespace $wgCapitalLinkOverrides).
hermes-project-hatnote:
Hatnote shown at the top of a translation-project page.
* $1 - the code of the project's language
hermestags-single:
Page title of [[Special:HermesTags]] when showing a single tag.
* $1 - the tag name
hermestags-legend: Legend of the filter form on [[Special:HermesTags]].
hermestags-tag: Label for the tag name filter on [[Special:HermesTags]]: only tags containing the given text are listed.
hermestags-language: Label for the language selection on [[Special:HermesTags]]: only the selected languages are shown.
hermestags-conflicts-only: Label for the checkbox on [[Special:HermesTags]] that only lists tags set on more than one page for the same language and fallback priority.
hermestags-submit:
{{Identical|Show}}
Submit button of the filter form on [[Special:HermesTags]].
hermestags-header-tag: Column header on [[Special:HermesTags]]: the tag name.
hermestags-header-priority:
Header of the first column on a single tag's page of [[Special:HermesTags]], above the languages; the other columns are numbered by fallback priority, where 0 is tried first.
{{Identical|Priority}}
hermestags-empty: Shown on [[Special:HermesTags]] if no tags match the filters.
hermespages-legend: Legend of the filter form on [[Special:HermesPages]].
hermespages-title: Label for the page title filter on [[Special:HermesPages]].
hermespages-header-language:
Column header on [[Special:HermesPages]]: the page's language.
{{Identical|Language}}
hermespages-single:
Page title of [[Special:HermesPages]] when showing a single page.
* $1 - the page's title
hermespages-notfound:
Shown on [[Special:HermesPages]] if the page given in the URL has no Hermes tags or doesn't exist.
* $1 - the requested language code and title
hermespages-header-priority:
Column header on [[Special:HermesPages]]: the page's tag with this fallback priority.
* $1 - the priority, where 0 is tried first
hermes-page-details: Tooltip and accessible label of the magnifying glass icon after links to pages on Hermes special pages, linking to the page's details on [[Special:HermesPages]].
hermeslanguages-header-wiki:
Column header on [[Special:HermesLanguages]]: the wiki serving the language.
{{Identical|Wiki}}
hermeslanguages-header-pages:
Column header on [[Special:HermesLanguages]]: the number of pages with Hermes tags in the language.
{{Identical|Page}}
hermeslanguages-add-submit:
Submit button of the form on [[Special:HermesLanguages]] for adding a translation project.
{{Identical|Add}}
hermeslanguages-add-placeholder: Empty first option of the language dropdown on [[Special:HermesLanguages]] for adding a translation project.
hermestranslate-page:
Label for the field on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] for the page to translate.
{{Identical|Page}}
hermestranslate-language: Label for the dropdown on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] for the translation project to translate into.
hermestranslate-submit:
Submit button on [[Special:HermesTranslate]], opening the editor for the new translation.
{{Identical|Translate}}
hermes-translate-action-tooltip: Tooltip of the {{msg-mw|hermes-translate-action}} action in the page actions menu.
hermestranslate-no-base:
Error on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] when the page to translate does not exist, or is in a namespace without translation projects.
* $1 - the page name as entered
hermestranslate-no-projects: Shown on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] instead of the form when the wiki has no translation projects.
hermestranslate-translation: Label for the field on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] for the title of the translation, without the translation project prefix.
hermestranslate-invalid-title:
Error on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] when the translated title is not a valid page title.
* $1 - the title as entered
hermestranslate-exists:
Error on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] when a page with the translated title already exists.
* $1 - link to that page
hermes-translate-action:
Label of the action in the page actions menu opening [[Special:HermesTranslate]] for the current page.
{{Identical|Translate}}
hermestranslate-language-placeholder: Empty first option of the translation project dropdown on [[Special:HermesTranslate]].
hermestranslate-all-translated:
Notice on [[Special:HermesTranslate]] when the page to translate already has a translation in every translation project of the wiki.
* $1 - the page name
hermestranslate-title:
Page title of [[Special:HermesTranslate]] for a given page.
* $1 - the name of the page to translate
hermeswanted-project: Label of the translation project filter on [[Special:WantedTranslations]] and [[Special:WantedCategoryTranslations]].
hermeswanted-all:
Option of the translation project filter on [[Special:WantedTranslations]] and [[Special:WantedCategoryTranslations]] showing all projects.
{{Identical|All}}
hermes-pref-displaylanguage: Label of the radio buttons choosing the interface language in [[Special:Preferences]].
hermes-pref-displaylanguage-default: Radio option: show the interface in the content language of the page (the wiki's language, or a translation project's language on its pages).
hermes-pref-displaylanguage-base: Radio option: show the interface in the wiki's main language, also on translation project pages.
hermes-pref-displaylanguage-spoken: Radio option: show the interface in the page's language if it is in the user's list of spoken languages, otherwise in the first language of that list.
hermes-pref-displaylanguage-spoken-label: Label of the list of languages the user speaks besides their preferred language.
hermes-pref-displaylanguage-spoken-help: Help text of the list of languages the user speaks besides their preferred language.
hermes-pref-displaylanguage-preferred: Label of the dropdown choosing the user's preferred interface language (preselected: the wiki's main language), used where the user doesn't speak the language of the current page.
hermes-pref-variant:
Label of the radio buttons choosing the variant (e.g. script) in which content and interface in a language with variants are shown, one per language of the wiki family that has variants, in [[Special:Preferences]].

Parameters:
* $1 - the language, as "autonym (code)"
